traces.GPU: WebGPU + WGSL: exposure -> adapter -> device (features/limits) -> readback -> shader -> expiry/loss
traces.NN: WebNN: exposure -> policy -> createContext -> context lost
traces.MC: Media Capture: exposure -> permissions + policy -> getUserMedia failure -> track ended
traces.GS: Generic Sensor: maturity -> exposure -> reading conditions -> start/permission -> policy check
traces.MS: motion sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, orientation): maturity -> exposure -> feature/permission
traces.ES: environment sensors (proximity, ambient light): maturity -> exposure -> policy -> quantization
traces.DO: Device Orientation and Motion: permissions/policy -> requestPermission activation -> exposure -> at-risk integration
traces.GEO: Geolocation: exposure without SecureContext -> non-secure denial -> policy -> permission -> visibility
traces.XR: WebXR: exposure -> policy -> non-prompting support query -> activation -> device -> session end
traces.DEV: device choosers (HID, USB, Serial, Bluetooth): exposure -> policy + activation -> default allowlist -> disconnect/forget
traces.WK: Dedicated workers: exposure (no gate) -> construction -> terminate
traces.STO: storage surfaces: StorageManager, OPFS root, CacheStorage exposure
traces.WJ: WebAssembly JS API: validate/instantiate, ungated by context, permission or policy

constraints.statement: Interface exposure never admits a capability: admission requires the family's secure-context, policy, permission/chooser and request gates to pass and a known-answer to execute (e.g. Geolocation is exposed without [SecureContext] yet denies every request in a non-secure context; WebNN createContext can reject after navigator.ml is present)

Families whose request algorithm requires transient activation or a chooser (HID, USB, Serial, Bluetooth, immersive XR, device-orientation permission) carry a probe obligation that names its automation path (user gesture, granted permission state, or virtual device); without one they stay [OBS]/[GAP], never [RUN]

facts.subject: Generic Sensor family maturity (sensors, accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, orientation, proximity, ambient light)
facts.predicate: every Generic Sensor family editor's draft carries an advisement at its tip: Generic Sensor is Chromium-only and not expected to advance; Accelerometer, Gyroscope and Orientation Sensor are maintained for existing deployments and direct new projects to Device Orientation and Motion; Magnetometer and Ambient Light are not available by default in any engine; Proximity is implemented by no engine
facts.note: maturity only: no family leaves G (CON-FT-002); whether FactTest's motion-capability contracts should route through Device Orientation and Motion is a D18 decision

facts.subject: HID, USB, Serial, Bluetooth, immersive XR, device orientation permission
facts.predicate: each request algorithm rejects without transient activation (and, for HID/USB/Serial/Bluetooth, shows a chooser): headless automation cannot reach admission without a user gesture, a pre-granted state or a virtual device path
facts.note: probe obligation for these families needs automation (virtual devices / permission overrides): implementation side is D17
